content: Tensions are clearly present in the textual data of the respective countries. That same year, however, India and Pakistan casted very similar votes in the UN, with ideal points of -0.797 and -0.739, respectively. Therefore, both sources of data appear to provide useful signals of different aspects of underlying state preferences.
